entities.summary: Vance Richard Worley is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Philadelphia Phillies, Minnesota Twins, Pittsburgh Pirates, Baltimore Orioles, and Miami Marlins. Worley has also represented Great Britain internationally.
